tiles.title: Filesystem Usage
chartQuery: 100 * max by (container, device) ({__name__="container_fs_usage_bytes",container!="",node=~"$node",project=~"$project",service=~"$service",container=~"$container"}) / max by (container, device) ({__name__="container_fs_limit_bytes",container!="",node=~"$node",project=~"$project",service=~"$service",container=~"$container"})

tiles.title: Inode Utilization
chartQuery: 100 * (1 - max by (container, device) ({__name__="container_fs_inodes_free",container!="",node=~"$node",project=~"$project",service=~"$service",container=~"$container"}) / max by (container, device) ({__name__="container_fs_inodes_total",container!="",node=~"$node",project=~"$project",service=~"$service",container=~"$container"}))

tiles.title: Container Inventory
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE(container, name, 'unknown') AS container_name,
  COALESCE(image, 'unknown') AS image,
  COALESCE(project, 'unassigned') AS project,
  COALESCE(service, 'unassigned') AS service,
  COALESCE(role, 'unassigned') AS role,
  COUNT(DISTINCT metric_name) AS metric_families,
  COUNT(DISTINCT __series_hash_u64) AS series,
  MAX(p_timestamp) AS latest
FROM $metrics_dataset
WHERE container IS NOT NULL AND container <> ''
GROUP BY container_name, image, project, service, role
ORDER BY container_name

tiles.title: cAdvisor Version
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "cadvisorVersion" AS cadvisor_version, "cadvisorRevision" AS revision, "kernelVersion" AS kernel_version, "osVersion" AS os_version, MAX(p_timestamp) AS latest
FROM $metrics_dataset
WHERE metric_name = 'cadvisor_version_info'
GROUP BY "cadvisorVersion", "cadvisorRevision", "kernelVersion", "osVersion"
ORDER BY latest DESC

tiles.title: Sample Volume Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, COUNT(*) AS samples
FROM $metrics_dataset
GROUP BY time_bin
ORDER BY time_bin

tiles.title: Metric Inventory
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT metric_name, metric_type, metric_unit, COUNT(*) AS samples, COUNT(DISTINCT __series_hash_u64) AS series, MIN(p_timestamp) AS first_seen, MAX(p_timestamp) AS last_seen
FROM $metrics_dataset
GROUP BY metric_name, metric_type, metric_unit
ORDER BY samples DESC
